categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. (Chipscreen) is a pioneering Chinese innovative drug company focused on original small molecule drug discovery and development. Its primary business segments include research and development, production, and commercialization of innovative drugs targeting malignant tumors, metabolic diseases, autoimmune diseases, central nervous system diseases, and antiviral therapies. The company has established a complete industrial chain from early exploratory discovery to commercialization, with two marketed innovative drugs and multiple clinical-stage projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary integrated drug discovery platform based on chemical genomics and AI-assisted design, incorporating AI models such as Huawei Cloud's EIHealth and Hermite drug design platforms. This platform supports early-stage drug discovery, molecular design, structure optimization, and clinical development strategies. Production adheres to GMP standards with manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Chengdu, employing planned and order-controlled production modes to ensure quality and supply stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chipscreen primarily serves hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare providers across China, focusing on patients with malignant tumors, metabolic diseases like type 2 diabetes and metabolic-associated fatty liver disease, and autoimmune conditions. Key customers include major pharmaceutical distributors and medical institutions. The company also targets global markets through international clinical trials and partnerships, with products approved and marketed in China, Japan, Taiwan, and ongoing trials in the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant commercial presence in major regions including South China, North China, East China, Southwest, Northwest, Central China, Northeast, Taiwan, and the United States. It has subsidiaries and production facilities in Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Pengzhou, and conducts international clinical trials and collaborations, particularly in the US and Greater China region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chipscreen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations, and commercial sales and marketing. It controls production of its key drugs and manages distribution through self-built commercial teams and authorized distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation driven by AI-assisted chemical genomics platforms to discover first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule drugs. Strategic R&D priorities include oncology, metabolic diseases, autoimmune diseases, CNS disorders, and antiviral therapies. It focuses on clinical value-driven development, expanding indications, and global registration. The company also invests heavily in clinical trials, including combination therapies and international multi-center studies, while continuously optimizing its R&D pipeline and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary innovative drugs, including direct sales to hospitals and pharmacies via distributors. Additional revenue streams include technology licensing and authorization fees. The company also benefits from government subsidies and grants related to R&D and innovation. Sales are supported by academic promotion and market access efforts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chipscreen positions itself as a leading Chinese original innovative drug developer with a strong focus on small molecule drugs and AI-driven discovery. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies in oncology and metabolic disease markets. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology platforms, a diversified pipeline, and established commercial presence. The company faces competition from multinational pharma and emerging biotech firms but maintains a leading role in China's innovative drug sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chipscreen reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 658 million, a 25.63% increase year-over-year, driven by strong sales growth of its key products Chidamide and Chiglitazar. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 114.57 million, reflecting continued high R&D investment (51.49% of revenue). Total assets reached RMB 3.25 billion with steady growth. The company is in a growth phase, expanding clinical pipelines and commercial footprint while managing profitability challenges typical of innovative drug developers.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chipscreen emphasizes its unique AI-assisted chemical genomics drug discovery platform enabling early and effective identification of differentiated, clinically valuable molecules. Its flagship products, Chidamide (a subtype-selective HDAC inhibitor) and Chiglitazar (a global first PPAR pan-agonist), offer innovative mechanisms addressing unmet clinical needs in oncology and metabolic diseases. The company highlights strong clinical evidence, multi-indication approvals, inclusion in national formularies, and comprehensive quality and supply chain management as key differentiators delivering value to patients and healthcare systems.
